title: ws-hwdrivers stream 3: npmx fuel-gauge wrapper (process_fuel_gauge_51201c + 3 fg fns) verified vs stock

method.emulator: Renode 1.17.0, CPU CortexM cortex-m55, FPU on
method.harness: build/ws-hwdrivers-20261122/harness (hw.repl/harness.c/rt.S/tramp.S + per-unit gen_<unit>.c), final arg-comparing + VFP-aware harness
method.compare: per test: return value, stub-call arg lists (0xB7), i2c transaction + 128x256 register-image diff, caller/global dump images, register diffs. Stack-local and elog string-literal pointers canonicalized.
method.runstock: npmx library fns (incl nrf_fuel_gauge_process_55f848, npmx_adc_meas_all_get 0x55f654) defsym'd to stock addresses and executed as real stock code for BOTH variants; PREINIT=npmx_backend_init_511108; snapshot region (0x20070ce0,0x3c00) covers the nrf model state + backend + ref_time, restored per variant.

harness_fidelity_fixes: ROOT CAUSE of process_fuel_gauge 0/12: NOT a float diff and NOT a reconstruction defect. The first diff was at g2_charger_telemetry.temperature (0x20073b28), with absurd values and a test-N-C==test-N+1-stock carryover signature (stack reuse). temperature=(int)(temp*100); temp=meas.values[1] from the reconstructed get_adc -> run-stock npmx_adc_meas_all_get (0x55f654). That function stores a channel only if a per-channel handler fn-ptr in a RAM table at 0x20002e0c (literal @0x55f744) is non-NULL. Lazy-init only fills table[4..7]; table[0..3] (ch0 voltage, ch1 temp) are set only by full ADC config, which PREINIT never runs -> ch0/ch1 skipped -> meas.values[0]/[1] left as uninitialized stack, differing between IAR(stock) and clang(C) frames. 0x20002e0c is outside the snapshot region and not a g_data entry, so nothing reset it.

FIX (proven harness artifact): PRELOAD_WORDS['npmxfg'] seeds the ADC handler table 0x20002e0c[0..7] = 0x55f319 (the generic stock convert handler the lazy-init itself uses), applied per variant by setup_data. All ADC channels now convert deterministically from the seeded i2c codes, identically for both variants. This does NOT mask any real C-vs-stock diff because npmx_adc_meas_all_get is run-stock for both variants; it only makes the ADC INPUT deterministic+identical.
Also widened npmxfg snapshot to (0x20070ce0,0x3c00) and grew g_isnap to 0x4000 to cover the nrf model state.
relation_to_prior_proof: The earlier bit-exact proof g2-20261122-fuel-gauge-process-c.json was for the MATH LEAF nrf_model_process_43a698 (explicit float inputs) - a different function from this wrapper. No conflict.
